verses.text: One reed like rod dem give me, dey talk say, “Rise, measure di temple of God, and di altar, and dem wey dey worship inside am.
But leave di court wey dey outside di temple, and no measure am, for dem don give am to di nations. Dem go tread di holy city under foot for 42 months.
I go give power to my two witnesses, and dem go prophesy for 1,260 days, dress in sackcloth.”
Dis na di two olive trees and di two lampstands wey dey stand before di Lord of di earth.
If anybody wan harm dem, fire go come out of dem mouth and destroy dem enemies. If anybody wan harm dem, na so e must dey killed.

Dis people get power to shut heaven, so that rain no go fall for di days of dem prophecy; and dem get power over di waters to turn dem to blood, and to strike di earth with every plague, as many times as dem wish.
When dem don finish dem testimony, di beast wey dey come up out of di abyss go make war with dem, and overcome dem, and kill dem.
Dem body go lie for di street of di great city, wey dem dey call Sodom and Egypt in di spirit, wia dem also nail dem Lord to di cross.
People from di peoples, tribes, languages and nations go look dem body for three and half days, and dem no go allow dem body to enter tomb.
Dem wey dey dwell on di earth go rejoice over dem, make merry, and send gifts to each other, because dis two prophets torment dem wey dey dwell on di earth.
After di three and half days, breath of life from God enter dem, and dem stand on dem feet; and great fear fall on dem wey dey look dem.
I hear loud voice from heaven talk to dem, “Come up here!” Dem go up to heaven inside di cloud, and dem enemies look dem.
For dat hour big earthquake happen, and di tenth part of di city fall; and 7,000 people die inside di earthquake; and di rest fear, and give glory to di God of heaven.
Di second woe don pass. Look, di third woe dey come quickly.
Di seventh angel sound, and loud voices dey inside heaven, dey talk say, “Di kingdom of di world don become di kingdom of our Lord and of im Christ. E go reign forever and ever!”
Di 24 elders wey dey sit before God for dem thrones fall on dem faces and worship God,
dey talk say, “We thank you, di Lord God, di Almighty, wey dey and wey don dey, because you don take your great power and begin to reign.

Di nations dey angry, but your wrath don come, and di time for di dead to dey judged, and to give reward to your servants di prophets, and di holy people, and dem wey fear your name, di small and di great; and to destroy dem wey dey destroy di earth.”
God temple open inside heaven, and di ark of im covenant show inside im temple. Lightnings, voices, thunders, earthquake and great hail happen.
One great sign show for heaven: one woman dress with di sun, and di moon dey under im feet, and for im head one crown of 12 stars.
Di woman dey pregnant. E cry out in labour, dey suffer to born.
Another sign show for heaven: look, one great red dragon, wey get seven heads and ten horns, and for im heads seven crowns.
Im tail drag di third part of di stars of heaven, and throw dem to di earth. Di dragon stand before di woman wey wan born, so that when e born, e go swallow im pikin.
E born pikin, one male pikin, wey go rule all di nations with iron rod. Dem catch im pikin up to God and to im throne.
Di woman run enter di wilderness, wia e get place wey God prepare, so that dem go feed am for 1,260 days.
War start inside heaven: Michael and im angels fight against di dragon; di dragon and im angels fight back.
Dem no win, and dem place no dey found again inside heaven.
Di great dragon, di old snake wey dem dey call di devil and Satan, wey deceive di whole world, dem throw am down to di earth, and dem throw im angels down with am.

I hear loud voice inside heaven talk say, “Now di salvation, di power, di kingdom of our God, and di authority of im Christ don come; for di accuser of our brothers don dey thrown down, di one wey dey accuse dem before our God day and night.
Dem overcome am because of di blood of di Lamb and because of di word of dem testimony, and dem no love dem life even to death.
So rejoice, heavens and una wey dey dwell inside dem. Woe to di earth and di sea, because di devil don come down to una, with great anger, because e know say e get short time.”
When di dragon see say dem don throw am to di earth, e chase di woman wey born di male pikin.
Dem give di woman two wings of di great eagle, so that e go fly enter di wilderness to im place, wia dem dey feed am for time, times and half time, far from di face of di snake.
Di snake throw water like river out of im mouth after di woman, so that e go carry am away with di flood.
Di earth help di woman, and di earth open im mouth and swallow di river wey di dragon throw out of im mouth.
Di dragon dey angry with di woman, and e go make war with di rest of im seed, dem wey keep God commandments and get di testimony of Jesus.
Di dragon stand on di sand of di sea. I see one beast dey come up out of di sea, wey get ten horns and seven heads, and for im horns ten crowns, and for im heads names of blasphemy.
Di beast wey I see like leopard, im feet na like bear own, and im mouth like lion mouth. Di dragon give am im power, im throne and great authority.
One of im heads like say dem don kill am to death, and im death wound don heal. Di whole earth wonder and follow di beast.
Dem worship di dragon, because e give authority to di beast; and dem worship di beast, dey talk say, “Who fit compare with di beast? Who fit make war with am?”
Dem give am mouth wey dey talk great things and blasphemies. Dem give am authority to act for 42 months.
E open im mouth for blasphemies against God, to blaspheme im name, im tent, and dem wey dey dwell inside heaven.
Dem give am power to make war with di holy people and to overcome dem. Dem give am authority over every tribe, people, language and nation.
All wey dey dwell on di earth go worship am, everyone wey dem never write im name inside di book of life of di Lamb wey dem kill from di foundation of di world.
If anybody get ear, make e hear.
If anybody dey go for captivity, e go go for captivity. If anybody go kill with sword, e must dey killed with sword. Here na di patience and di faith of di holy people.
I see another beast dey come up out of di earth. E get two horns like lamb, and e dey talk like dragon.
E dey use all di authority of di first beast for im presence. E dey make di earth and dem wey dey dwell inside am worship di first beast, wey im death wound don heal.
E dey do great signs, even to make fire come down from heaven to di earth for people eyes.

E dey deceive dem wey dey dwell on di earth because of di signs wey dem give am power to do before di beast, dey tell dem wey dey dwell on di earth to make image for di beast wey get di wound of di sword and don live.
Dem give am power to give breath to di image of di beast, so that di image of di beast go even talk, and cause as many as no worship di image of di beast to dey killed.
E dey make all, di small and di great, di rich and di poor, di free and di slaves, to receive mark on dem right hand or on dem forehead;
so that nobody fit buy or sell, except di one wey get di mark, di name of di beast or di number of im name.
Here na wisdom. Make di one wey get understanding count di number of di beast, for na number of man. Im number na 666.
I look, and look, di Lamb dey stand on di Mount Zion, and with am 144,000, wey get im name and im Papa name write for dem foreheads.
I hear voice from heaven, like sound of many waters, and like sound of loud thunder. Di voice wey I hear na like harpists dey play dem harps.
Dem dey sing like new song before di throne, and before di four living creatures and di elders. Nobody fit learn di song except di 144,000, dem wey dem don buy from di earth.
Dis na dem wey no stain dem own selves with women, for dem na virgins. Dis na dem wey dey follow di Lamb wherever e go. Dem buy dem from among men, as firstfruits to God and to di Lamb.
For dem mouth, dem no find lie; dem no get fault.
I see another angel dey fly inside di middle of heaven, wey get Good News wey no dey end to proclaim to dem wey dey dwell on di earth, and to every nation, tribe, language and people;
e dey talk with loud voice, “Fear God, and give am glory, for di hour of im judgment don come. Worship am wey make heaven, di earth, di sea and di springs of waters!”
Another, one second angel, follow am, talk say, “Fallen, fallen na Babylon di great, wey make all di nations drink di wine of di anger of im sexual immorality!”
Another angel, di third, follow dem, talk with loud voice, “If anybody worship di beast and im image, and receive mark on im forehead or on im hand,
e too go drink di wine of God wrath, wey dem pour full strength inside di cup of im anger. E go dey tormented with fire and sulphur before di holy angels and before di Lamb.
Di smoke of dem torment go dey go up forever and ever. Dem no get rest day or night, dem wey worship di beast and im image, and anybody wey receive di mark of im name.”
Here na di patience of di holy people, dem wey keep God commandments and di faith of Jesus.
I hear voice from heaven talk say, “Write: Blessed na di dead wey die inside di Lord from now on.” “Yes,” talk di Spirit, “so that dem go rest from dem labours, for dem works dey follow dem.”
I look, and look, one white cloud, and on di cloud one sitting like Son of Man, wey get golden crown on im head, and sharp sickle for im hand.
Another angel come out of di temple, dey cry with loud voice to di one wey dey sit on di cloud, “Send out your sickle and reap, for di hour to reap don come, for di harvest of di earth don dry.”
Di one wey sit on di cloud throw im sickle on di earth, and dem reap di earth.
Another angel come out of di temple wey dey inside heaven, e too get sharp sickle.

Another angel come out from di altar, wey get authority over fire, and e cry with loud cry to di one wey get di sharp sickle, “Send out your sharp sickle, and gather di clusters of di vine of di earth, for im grapes don ripe.”
Di angel throw im sickle to di earth, and gather di vine of di earth, and throw am enter di great winepress of God anger.
Dem tread di winepress outside di city, and blood come out of di winepress, even to di horses bridles, for 1,600 stadia.
I see another sign inside heaven, great and wonderful: seven angels wey get di seven last plagues, for inside dem God anger don finish.
I see something like sea of glass mixed with fire, and dem wey overcome di beast, im image and di number of im name dey stand on di sea of glass, wey get harps of God.

Dem dey sing di song of Moses, God servant, and di song of di Lamb, dey talk say, “Great and wonderful na your works, di Lord God, di Almighty. Righteous and true na your ways, you King of di nations.
Who no go fear you, di Lord, and glorify your name? For you only holy. For all di nations go come and worship before you, for your righteous acts don show.”
After dis I look, and di temple of di tent of di testimony open inside heaven.
Di seven angels wey get di seven plagues come out of di temple, dress in clean bright linen, and tie golden belts round dem chests.
One of di four living creatures give di seven angels seven golden bowls full of di anger of God, wey dey alive forever and ever.
Di temple full with smoke from God glory and from im power. Nobody fit enter di temple until di seven plagues of di seven angels don finish.
I hear loud voice from di temple talk to di seven angels, “Go and pour out di seven bowls of God anger on di earth.”
Di first go and pour out im bowl on di earth, and bad and painful sore come on di people wey get di mark of di beast and worship im image.
Di second angel pour out im bowl on di sea, and e turn blood like of dead man; and every living thing for di sea die.
Di third angel pour out im bowl on di rivers and di springs of waters, and dem turn blood.
I hear di angel of di waters talk say, “You righteous, wey dey and wey don dey, di Holy One, because you don judge dis things.
For dem pour out di blood of di holy people and di prophets, and you don give dem blood to drink. Dem deserve am.”
I hear di altar talk say, “Yes, di Lord God, di Almighty, true and righteous na your judgments.”
Di fourth angel pour out im bowl on di sun, and dem give am power to burn men with fire.
Men burn with great heat, and dem blaspheme di name of God wey get power over dis plagues, and dem no repent to give am glory.
Di fifth angel pour out im bowl on di throne of di beast, and im kingdom turn dark. Dem chew dem tongues for pain,
and dem blaspheme di God of heaven because of dem pains and dem sores, and dem no repent of dem works.
Di sixth angel pour out im bowl on di great river Euphrates, and im water dry up, so that di way for di kings wey come from di sunrise go ready.
I see three evil spirits like frogs come out of di mouth of di dragon, out of di mouth of di beast, and out of di mouth of di false prophet.
Dem na evil spirits wey dey do signs; dem go out to di kings of di whole world, to gather dem to di war of di great day of God, di Almighty.
“Look, I dey come like thief. Blessed na di one wey dey watch and keep im clothes, so that e no go walk naked and dem see im shame.”
Dem gather dem together to di place wey dem dey call for Hebrew Armageddon.
Di seventh angel pour out im bowl on di air, and loud voice come out of di temple from di throne, dey talk say, “E don finish!”
Lightnings, voices and thunders happen; and big earthquake happen, so strong and so big tay nothing like am don happen since men dey on di earth.
Di great city divide into three parts, and di cities of di nations fall. Dem remember Babylon di great before God, to give am di cup of di wine of im fierce anger.
Every island run away, and dem no find mountains.
Great hail, each stone about di weight of one talent, fall down out of heaven on men; and men blaspheme God because of di plague of di hail, for im plague big well well.
One of di seven angels wey get di seven bowls come and talk with me, say, “Come here. I go show you di judgment of di great prostitute wey dey sit on many waters,
wey di kings of di earth commit sexual immorality with, and dem wey dey dwell on di earth drunk with di wine of im sexual immorality.”
E carry me away inside di Spirit enter wilderness. I see one woman dey sit on scarlet beast, full of names of blasphemy, wey get seven heads and ten horns.
Di woman dress in purple and scarlet, and decorate with gold, precious stone and pearls, wey get golden cup inside im hand full of abominations and di filthiness of im sexual immorality,
and for im forehead dem write name, mystery: “Babylon di great, di mama of di prostitutes and of di abominations of di earth.”
I see di woman drunk with di blood of di holy people, and with di blood of di witnesses of Jesus. When I see am, I wonder with great wonder.
Di angel talk to me, “Why you wonder? I go tell you di mystery of di woman, and of di beast wey carry am, wey get di seven heads and di ten horns.

Di beast wey you see, e dey, and e no dey, and e go come up out of di abyss and go to destruction. Dem wey dey dwell on di earth, dem wey dem no write dem names inside di book of life from di foundation of di world, go wonder when dem see di beast, how e dey, and e no dey, and e go dey again.
Here na di mind wey get wisdom. Di seven heads na seven mountains, wia di woman dey sit.
Dem na seven kings. Five don fall, one dey, di other never come; and when e come, e must stay small time.
Di beast wey dey, and no dey, na even di eighth, and e dey among di seven, and e dey go to destruction.
Di ten horns wey you see na ten kings, wey never receive kingdom yet; but dem receive authority as kings with di beast for one hour.
Dis people get one mind, and dem give dem power and authority to di beast.
Dis people go make war with di Lamb, and di Lamb go overcome dem, for e na Lord of lords and King of kings; and dem wey dey with am na dem wey dem don call, chosen and faithful.”
E talk to me, “Di waters wey you see, wia di prostitute dey sit, na peoples, multitudes, nations and languages.
Di ten horns wey you see, and di beast, dem go hate di prostitute, and go make am desolate and naked, and go chop im flesh, and burn am with fire.
For God don put am inside dem heart to carry out im purpose, by agreeing together and giving dem kingdom to di beast, until God words go complete.
Di woman wey you see na di great city, wey dey reign over di kings of di earth.”
After dis things I see another angel dey come down from heaven, wey get great authority, and di earth bright with im glory.
E cry with strong voice, talk say, “Fallen, fallen na Babylon di great, and e don become home for evil spirits, and prison for every evil spirit, and prison for every unclean and hated bird!

For all di nations don drink of di wine of di anger of im sexual immorality, and di kings of di earth commit sexual immorality with am, and di merchants of di earth grow rich through di power of im luxury.”
I hear another voice from heaven talk say, “Come out of am, my people, so that una no go share for im sins, and so that una no go receive of im plagues,
for im sins don pile up reach heaven, and God don remember im iniquities.
Give am back even as e give, and pay am double according to im works; for di cup wey e mix, mix double for am.
As much as e give im own self glory and live luxuriously, so much torment and sorrow give am. For e talk for im heart say, ‘I sit as queen, and I no be widow, and I no go ever see sorrow.’
So for one day im plagues go come, death, mourning and famine; and dem go burn am with fire, for di Lord God wey judge am strong.”
Di kings of di earth, wey commit sexual immorality and live luxuriously with am, go cry and mourn over am, when dem see di smoke of im burning,
dey stand far away for di fear of im torment, dey talk say, “Woe, woe, di great city, Babylon, di strong city! For for one hour your judgment don come.”
Di merchants of di earth dey cry and mourn over am, because nobody dey buy dem cargo again;
cargo of gold, silver, precious stone, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, and every thyine wood, every article of ivory, every article of most precious wood, brass, iron and marble;
cinnamon, spice, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, bodies, and souls of men.
Di fruit wey your soul desire don leave you, and all di fine and bright things don perish from you, and nobody go ever find dem again.
Di merchants of dis things, wey get rich from am, go stand far away for di fear of im torment, dey cry and mourn,
dey talk say, “Woe, woe, di great city, wey dress in fine linen, purple and scarlet, and decorate with gold, precious stone and pearls!
For for one hour all dis great riches don waste.” Every ship captain, and everyone wey sail anywhere, and sailors, and as many as work for sea, stand far away,
and cry out as dem see di smoke of im burning, dey talk say, “Which city dey like di great city?”

Dem throw dust on dem heads, and cry, dey weep and mourn, dey talk say, “Woe, woe, di great city, wia all wey get ships for di sea grow rich by reason of im costliness! For for one hour e don desolate.
Rejoice over am, heaven, and una holy people, apostles and prophets; for God don judge im case for una.”
One strong angel lift up stone like big millstone and throw am enter di sea, talk say, “Na so with violence dem go throw Babylon, di great city, down, and nobody go ever find am again.

Di sound of harpists, musicians, flute players and trumpeters no go ever hear for you again; and no craftsman of any craft go ever dey found inside you again; and di sound of millstone no go ever hear inside you again;

and di light of lamp no go ever shine inside you again; and di voice of bridegroom and bride no go ever hear inside you again; for your merchants na di great men of di earth; for by your sorcery all di nations dey deceived.
Inside am dem find di blood of prophets and of di holy people, and of all wey dem don slaughter for di earth.”
After dis I hear something like loud voice of great multitude inside heaven, dey talk say, “Hallelujah! Salvation, glory, honour and power belong to our God,
for im judgments true and righteous. For e don judge di great prostitute wey corrupt di earth with im sexual immorality, and e don avenge di blood of im servants for im hand.”
Dem talk di second time, “Hallelujah! Im smoke dey go up forever and ever.”
Di 24 elders and di four living creatures fall down and worship God wey sit on di throne, dey talk say, “Amen! Hallelujah!”
One voice come out from di throne, dey talk say, “Praise our God, all im servants, una wey fear am, di small and di great!”
I hear something like voice of great multitude, and like sound of many waters, and like sound of strong thunders, dey talk say, “Hallelujah! For di Lord our God, di Almighty, reign.
Make we rejoice and dey glad, and give am di glory. For di wedding of di Lamb don come, and im wife don get ready.”
Dem give am to dress in fine linen, bright and clean, for di fine linen na di righteous acts of di holy people.
E talk to me, “Write: Blessed na dem wey dem invite to di wedding supper of di Lamb.” E talk to me, “Dis na di true words of God.”

I fall down before im feet to worship am. E talk to me, “No do am! I na fellow servant with you and with your brothers wey get di testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For di testimony of Jesus na di spirit of prophecy.”
I see heaven open, and look, one white horse, and di one wey dey sit on am dem dey call Faithful and True. For righteousness e dey judge and make war.
Im eyes na flame of fire, and on im head plenty crowns. E get name write wey nobody know except am alone.
E dress in garment wey dem dip inside blood. Im name dem call am God Word.
Di armies wey dey heaven, dress in white and clean fine linen, follow am on white horses.
Out of im mouth dey come sharp sword, so that with am e go strike di nations. E go rule dem with iron rod. E tread di winepress of di fierceness of di anger of God, di Almighty.
On im garment and on im thigh e get name write: King of kings and Lord of lords.
I see one angel dey stand for di sun. E cry with loud voice, dey talk to all di birds wey dey fly inside di middle of heaven, “Come, gather una together to di great supper of God,
so that una go chop di flesh of kings, di flesh of captains, di flesh of mighty men, di flesh of horses and of dem wey sit on dem, and di flesh of all men, both free and slave, small and great.”
I see di beast, di kings of di earth, and dem armies gather together to make war against di one wey sit on di horse and against im army.

Dem catch di beast, and with am di false prophet wey do di signs before am, wey e use deceive dem wey receive di mark of di beast and dem wey worship im image. Dem throw dem two alive enter di lake of fire wey dey burn with sulphur.
Di rest dem kill with di sword of di one wey sit on di horse, di sword wey come out of im mouth; and all di birds chop dem flesh well well.
I see one angel dey come down out of heaven, wey get di key of di abyss and big chain for im hand.
E catch di dragon, di old snake, wey be di devil and Satan, and tie am for 1,000 years,
and throw am enter di abyss, and shut am and seal am, so that e no go deceive di nations again, until di 1,000 years don finish. After dis, e must loose small time.

I see thrones, and dem sit on dem, and dem give dem judgment. I see di souls of dem wey dem don cut head because of di testimony of Jesus and because of God word, and dem wey no worship di beast or im image, and no receive di mark on dem forehead and on dem hand. Dem live and reign with Christ for 1,000 years.
Di rest of di dead no live again until di 1,000 years don finish. Dis na di first resurrection.
Blessed and holy na di one wey get part for di first resurrection. Over dem di second death no get power, but dem go be priests of God and of Christ, and go reign with am for 1,000 years.
When di 1,000 years don finish, Satan go loose from im prison,
and go go out to deceive di nations wey dey di four corners of di earth, Gog and Magog, to gather dem together to di war, dem number like di sand of di sea.
Dem go up on di breadth of di earth, and surround di camp of di holy people and di beloved city. Fire come down out of heaven and burn dem up.
Di devil wey deceive dem dem throw am enter di lake of fire and sulphur, wia di beast and di false prophet dey too. Dem go dey tormented day and night forever and ever.
I see one great white throne, and di one wey dey sit on am, from whose face di earth and di heaven run away, and no place dey found for dem.

I see di dead, di great and di small, dey stand before di throne, and books open. Another book open, wey na di book of life. Dem judge di dead out of di things wey dem write inside di books, according to dem works.
Di sea give up di dead wey dey inside am, and death and Hades give up di dead wey dey inside dem. Dem judge dem, each one according to im works.
Death and Hades dem throw enter di lake of fire. Dis na di second death, di lake of fire.
If anybody no dey found write inside di book of life, dem throw am enter di lake of fire.
